core_obligations: Reduce to a geometrically integral scheme (proof lines 2239-2250): the statement is immediate in characteristic zero or for perfect fields, so one assumes an infinite field of positive characteristic; one reduces to an irreducible scheme, replaces the base field by the finite separable field of global sections, and hence assumes the scheme geometrically integral.

Construct a convenient complete intersection (proof lines 2250-2285): for a closed point one chooses an ample invertible sheaf, a subspace of its sections vanishing at the point, and after twisting arranges that the sheaf is very ample, the sections generate over the complement of the point, the complement embeds into the projective space of the subspace, and the subspace surjects onto the cotangent space of the point; the tuples of sections generating that cotangent space form a nonempty open subset because the local ring is regular.

Apply Bertini and conclude (proof lines 2285-2310): for a sufficiently general tuple the intersection of the vanishing loci is the point together with a residual subscheme which by Bertini type statements is etale over the base field, hence zero dimensional; the intersection product of the classes of the vanishing loci equals the sum of the class of the point and the class of the residual scheme, so the class of the point is rationally equivalent to an integer combination of classes of points with separable residue fields.
proof_roadmap: Reduce to a geometrically integral scheme over a finite separable extension.
Choose an ample sheaf and a subspace of sections adapted to the chosen point.
Use Bertini to get an etale residual scheme and compute the intersection product.
difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that the group of zero cycles of a smooth projective scheme is generated by classes of closed points with separable residue field (statement lines 2232-2235). The proof (proof lines 2236-2310) reduces to a geometrically integral scheme, constructs a complete intersection through the chosen point whose residual scheme is etale by Bertini type statements, and computes the intersection product. H3: a lengthy constructive argument written out in full.
